set.body: Gallery regression after adding default panel expansion: GuidePolicy overrides with ticks=None are lowered against the expanded panel range, leaking padding endpoints into axis labels (for example DesignGraphics -1.55 and 32.55). Materialize explicit/override axis ticks from the unexpanded data range before layout assembly. Acceptance: regression asserts override tick values and labels are independent of RangeExpansion; DesignGraphics gallery axes no longer expose padding endpoints; JVM+JS graphics/SVG gates pass.
set.title: Graphics: keep explicit guide ticks independent of panel expansion
